authority_levels.meaning: retained source text/structured records may be quoted or normalized without adding missing rules
F009/F010/F016 implementation-ready design contracts are authoritative design inputs
PPIA-10 may define typed integration/authoring semantics where sources leave gaps, clearly labeled as design rather than recovered canon
state mutation, balance or content owned elsewhere remains delegated and may not be copied or redefined here

domain_handoffs.boundary: directional relationship edges, dimensions, Bonds/leverage/obligations and reveal ownership
interaction lifecycle, proposals, GM decisions and social resolution orchestration
faction placement, membership/rank/office, standing, influence, agenda/operation/alert and services
Campaign/Scene/Session placement, participants, launch/live history and session context
objective truth, evidence/clue/knowledge/reveal and investigation chronology boundaries
world/setting culture, jurisdiction, chronology, locations and setting-specific faction definitions
NPC identity, creature/NPC state and owning NPC records referenced by social/faction state
items, currency, custody and transfer remain inventory-owned
mechanical social-status/Condition application remains typed scoped status ownership
large permanent changes, obligations, projects and contracts remain owning-domain state
faction resources, assets, territory and locations are stable references without copied ownership
field/layer authorization, hidden existence, per-player reveals and revocation
expected-version, operation-id, status lookup, ordered Event recovery and revocation across devices
Player-proposed persistent consequences remain explicit authorized decisions; silence is not approval
final numeric balance and encounter effect authority remains downstream; PPIA-10 does not invent global balance constants

blocking_guardrails: Relationship edges are directional; reciprocal state requires a second explicit edge or explicit paired-edge contract.
No universal relationship, standing/reputation, influence or social DC scale may be invented.
Relationship, standing/reputation, influence, social status, mood, intent and stance remain distinct.
Membership, rank, office, permission, ownership, equipment and progression remain distinct.
Objective truth, NPC belief, Player belief, claim/lie, rumor, motive, secret and knowledge remain distinct.
Persuasion is not mind control; Insight is not automatic exact-truth reveal; Intimidation is not loyalty.
Hidden entity existence and fields are filtered before graph topology, counts, search, suggestions, exports, notifications, realtime, diagnostics and AI context.
Persistent Social Mode consequences use one accepted atomic Event group and delegated owning-domain Events; partial cross-domain commit is forbidden.
Faction standing change requires an attributable source Event and plausible information path.
External Item/NPC/Asset/Resource/Location/Project/Contract references do not transfer ownership into PPIA-10.
Source progression/capability records never automatically grant faction membership, rank, office, ownership, equipment or permission.
Source example DCs, Bond thresholds, reaction bands and standing tracks remain examples/profile data unless explicitly bound.
Authoritative mutations require authorization, expected_version and operation_id; ambiguous responses require status/current-version lookup before retry.
Offline mode permits bounded drafts/cached reads only, not authoritative social/relationship/faction mutation.
Graph/canvas position and visualization are nonauthoritative; semantic nonvisual list/table equivalents must preserve full authorized meaning and actions.
AI may validate, summarize or propose only from role-safe projections and has no irreversible NPC, reveal, decision, mutation or canonical authority.
No application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, deployment, release, tester, paid-service or production-credential activation is authorized by PPIA-10 design work.
